scripts.build: pnpm vite-plus:build:source && pnpm vite-plus:sync && pnpm effect-vitest:sync && pnpm build:packages && pnpm check:tsc-build
scripts.native:build: pnpm native:build:tsgo && pnpm native:build:tsgolint && pnpm native:build:oxlint
scripts.native:build:tsgo: cd native/typescript-go && mkdir -p built/local && GOCACHE=${GOCACHE:-/tmp/go-build-cache} GOTMPDIR=${GOTMPDIR:-/tmp} go build -o built/local/tsgo ./cmd/tsgo
scripts.native:build:tsgolint: cd native/tsgolint-effect-fork && GOWORK=off GOCACHE=${GOCACHE:-/tmp/go-build-cache} GOTMPDIR=${GOTMPDIR:-/tmp} go build -o tsgolint ./cmd/tsgolint
scripts.native:build:oxlint: cd native/oxc-oxlint-effect-fork && cargo build -p oxlint --release --features allocator --locked
scripts.publish:stage: pnpm build && pnpm native:stage && vp pm stage publish -r --filter './packages/*' --access public --provenance -- --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:stage:dry-run: pnpm build && pnpm native:stage && vp pm stage publish -r --filter './packages/*' --access public --provenance --dry-run -- --no-git-checks
